messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT PAGER — High error rate observed on production API (v1/generate). Symptoms: spike in 5xx and 429s. Auto-escalation to on-call. Priority: P1.

sre-oncall-anna: Ack. I'm paged and looking. Initial note: dashboards show 5xx jumping from ~0.3% to ~7.8% starting 1718409600. 429s increasing as well.

eng-runtime-mike: I see abnormal 429 burst in our rate-limiter metrics, and gateway 504s from the frontend. Could be backpressure causing queue timeouts.

network-ops-jay: Any recent deploys? I see a config push to rate-limit service at 1718409200 (deploy-bot confirmed).

deploy-bot: deploy:rate-limiter-service v2.3.1 rolled to prod at 1718409187 by eng-runtime-mike. Logs: rollout completed.

infra-jen: I'm checking pod restarts and infra. No autoscaling events around the spike. GCE instance pool steady.

support-lead-carol: Support is getting tickets from multiple tenants about timeouts and errors when calling /v1/generate. Major customer AcmeCorp reported retries failing.

product-dave: Please include impact estimation so we can decide whether to open status page.

sre-oncall-anna: Quick impact summary from metrics: 23% of requests to /v1/generate in the last 5m returned 5xx or 429. Around 12 tenants saw >10% error rate. P95 latency jumped from 420ms to 2.7s.

eng-runtime-mike: Dumping recent rate-limiter config and error logs.

eng-runtime-mike: ```
# rate-limiter config snippet
rules:
  - scope: tenant
    limit: 1000
    window: 60
  - scope: global
    limit: 50000
    window: 60
# recently added rule (v2.3.1)
  - scope: prefix: "/v1/generate"
    adapt: true
    penalty: heavy
```

eng-runtime-mike: Logs show the new "adapt" path is classifying long streaming requests as heavy and applying aggressive penalties => immediate 429s. Meanwhile frontends hit 429 and retry, building queue, causing gateway timeouts.

network-ops-jay: Confirming: frontends are retrying with short backoff, saturating backend connection pool. 504s originate from gateway proxy returning upstream timeout.

sre-oncall-anna: Proposed mitigation plan (fast):
1) Rollback rate-limiter config v2.3.1 (disable new adapt rule) OR temporarily set penalty to none.
2) Increase gateway connection pool + scale frontend pods by +30% to absorb retries.
3) Apply short-term global soft-throttle to non-billable/test tenants to free capacity for paid customers.
4) Notify support/product + update status page.

eng-runtime-mike: I can push a quick rollback to previous config. Command I'll run: 

``` 
kubectl set image deployment/rate-limiter rate-limiter=registry/rate-limiter:v2.3.0 --namespace=prod
```

infra-jen: I'll bump frontend HPA minReplicas from 6 to 9 and increase connection pool env var to 500.

support-lead-carol: Preparing customer comms: will message top affected accounts and post status page once we confirm mitigation working.

sre-oncall-anna: Doing the rollback now. Engs, stand by.

eng-runtime-mike: Rollback started at 1718409990. Watching metrics.

deploy-bot: Deployment change detected: rate-limiter -> v2.3.0 at 1718409998.

sre-oncall-anna: After rollback: 429 rate dropping — now 5xx+429 combined at 6.1% (was 23%). P95 latency down to 1.2s. Still above baseline.

infra-jen: HPA scaled frontends to 10 pods by 1718410105; connection pool increased. This reduced some 504s.

network-ops-jay: I've applied a temporary traffic class rule to deprioritize known test tenants (IDs: test-*) for 30m. That freed ~18% capacity.

sre-oncall-anna: Current status: errors trending down. Customer-facing impact reduced. Still monitoring for residual ripple.

product-dave: Good. Support, please update top 20 affected customers with ETA. Carol, can you draft?

support-lead-carol: Draft ready. Will send out once we have stable metrics for 10m.

eng-runtime-mike: Root cause hypothesis: the v2.3.1 rule misclassified streaming requests as heavy due to a heuristics change. The penalty triggered aggressive rejections (429) that produced retries and upstream timeouts (5xx).

sre-oncall-anna: Short postmortem notes and immediate A/C:
- Action1: Revert adapt logic from v2.3.1 and create safer rollout strategy (canary + slow ramp).
- Action2: Add circuit-breaker in frontend to stop aggressive retries on 429s for 10s.
- Action3: Instrument rate-limiter to expose affected-rule counters and per-tenant penalties.
- Action4: Run capacity test with synthetic streaming to validate behavior.

eng-runtime-mike: I'll own Action1 and Action3. ETA: start tomorrow 09:00 PT, complete by EOD.

infra-jen: I'll own Action2 and scaling playbook updates.

support-lead-carol: I'll coordinate customer comms and escalation to account teams.

sre-oncall-anna: For now: incident status -> mitigated. Keeping thread open for monitoring for 2h. If relapse, repage immediately.

product-dave: Should we post an initial status page? "Mitigated — partial customer impact earlier, rollback applied, monitoring"

support-lead-carol: Posting status now.

deploy-bot: status_page: updated (mitigated) at 1718410200.

sre-oncall-anna: Final check at 1718411190: combined 5xx+429 at 1.4% and steady. No further spikes in last 10m.

eng-runtime-mike: Will prepare a short blameless postmortem doc with timeline and tests.

sre-oncall-anna: Thanks team. Closing incident in 30m if stable.

support-lead-carol: Customer comms sent to affected accounts and CS triage opened for any escalations.

product-dave: Thanks all. Action items assigned.

sre-oncall-anna: Incident resolved (mitigated -> resolved) at 1718411200. Postmortem to be posted to #postmortems by EOD tomorrow.
